entities.name: MpaB W6R4H8
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt W6R4H8 (Penicillium roqueforti); annotated as ER-bound oxygenase in mycophenolic-acid biosynthesis.
Catalyzes oxidative cleavage of the C19–C20 double bond of farnesyl-DHMP through a mycophenolic aldehyde intermediate.

entities.name: RHEA:66688 oxidative cleavage
observations: UniProt-linked Rhea reaction: 4-farnesyl-3,5-dihydroxy-6-methylphthalide + AH2 + 2 O2 = FDHMP-3C product + acetone + A + H2O + H(+); proceeds via mycophenolic aldehyde.
Reaction reported as curated/reference mapping; specific identity of AH2/A not resolved in the protein report.
